name: A strongly coloured room raises arousal
claim: In three experiments, strong colours and patterns made the brain more excited than a grey room, and introverts and people in a bad mood reacted more.
caveat: The abstract is qualitative, and a later paper reports a higher heart rate in the blue room than in the red room, so do not encode a red-versus-blue direction.

sources.title: Kuller, Mikellides and Janssens 2009, Color, arousal, and performance: a comparison of three experiments, Color Research and Application 34(2)
